lines.intro: Hiii! I'm Crabby! Tap a white shell! Whoooosh! I will walk over! Paint it with your finger! Yaaay! Let's play!
lines.bedtime: Woohoo! You painted every shell! That was the WHOLE day! I'm sooo sleepy now. We all need to get some sleep. We can play again tomorrow. Night night!
